坡耕地退耕后，土壤和下游河流通常会发生什么变化？

What usually changes in the soil and the downstream river after slope farmland is retired?

上游泥沙减少、河水更清，下游河道淤积放缓、洪峰被植被"削平"；但短期内坡面产流可能改变，需要配套管护避免新的滑坡。
Upstream sediment drops and water clears, downstream aggradation slows and floods are "flattened" by vegetation—though short-term runoff shifts need management to avoid new slides.

退耕还林还草，为什么能减少水土流失？

Why does converting farmland back to forest and grassland reduce soil erosion?

坡地上庄稼收割后地表裸露，雨一冲土就跑；恢复林木草被后，根系抓土、落叶护表、减缓径流，土壤就被"留"住了。
On slopes, harvested crops leave bare soil that rain washes away; restored trees and grass use roots to hold soil, litter to shield the surface and slower runoff to keep soil in place.

#退耕还林 #水土流失 #根系

为什么退下来的坡地种树，反而比种粮更"护水"？

Why does planting trees on retired slopes protect water better than crops?

林木常年有叶有根，蒸腾与截留有节律，枯落物像海绵一样蓄水保土；而粮田翻耕频繁、裸露期长，更容易跑水跑土。
Trees keep leaves and roots year-round, transpiring and intercepting water while litter sponges up soil moisture; cropland is often tilled and bare, losing both water and soil.
